messages:
alina: Quick heads-upwe're scheduling a narrowwave tonight 00:45-02:15 UTC for runtime v3.1 (kernel batching) + router header-split. Need pin order, rollback SLOs, and who has pin rights. tagging @diego @wei @deploy-bot

deploy-bot: deploybot: reservation accepted: wave=20250422-0045. Run /preflight and /pin before start.

diego: Runtime has a known warm-start kv-shape change; prefer pin runtime first, then router, API last. Console can be feature-flagged.

wei: Ops: rollback triggers proposal -> 5xx > 2x baseline for 5m OR spike in model-serve-errors OR sustained p99 CPU > 85% for 3m. Fast path: drain traffic to 0% and unpin runtime.

alina: Rollout plan: pin runtime+router -> 10% (10m) -> 30% (15m) -> 100% if green. API pin at 30%. Console flag at 30% toggle.

deploy-bot: deploybot: preflight run recorded: 1733339500-staging-rt-v3.1-smoke. status: pass.

diego: I'll run a 20m soak in staging at 18:30 PT and validate router fallback to v3.0 path. Tagging @ops-runner.

ops-runner: confirmed. I'll put short-lived alerts: mem-delta, model-error, and latency-guard. Mute noisy perf alerts.

alina: Pin grant list: diego, alina, wei for runtime/router; api pin to alina+product. I'll post a 1-line release note to #release-notes.

wei: Ops checklist: health probes green, kv-evict thresholds, rollback script smoke tested. Rollback command: `/ops/rollback-wave --wave=20250422-0045 --component=runtime --target=v3.0 --drain=60s`.

alina: OK. If staging soak passes, we'll /start-wave at 00:45 UTC. I'll update this thread when live and on each step.
